handoff hints — Rules of the Road", "learner_facing": false, "markdown": "## C2 — KG handoff hints — Rules of the Road [A01]

Domain: Rules of the Road (Sec 9) | basis: pedagogic_emphasis only; no verified weights [A01]

FACT_ID: R09-01 | anchor: A01
Group: flex-lanes | Prereq: none | Difficulty: 2 | Confusable: R09-04
Flex-lane use follows overhead signal; green arrow open, red X closed [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0049]

FACT_ID: R09-02 | anchor: A01
Group: freeway-discipline | Prereq: R09-01 | Difficulty: 2 | Confusable: R09-03
Freeway: keep following gap, no U-turn, no emergency-lane driving, no ramp reversal [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0049]

FACT_ID: R09-03 | anchor: A01
Group: freeway-discipline | Prereq: R09-02 | Difficulty: 1 | Confusable: R09-02
Left-lane vehicle approached from behind must move right to avoid impeding [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0049]

FACT_ID: R09-04 | anchor: A02
Group: express-lanes | Prereq: R09-01 | Difficulty: 3 | Confusable: R09-01
Express lane needs qualifying occupancy; double white line crossing barred except at dotted access points [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0050]

FACT_ID: R09-05 | anchor: A02
Group: express-lanes | Prereq: R09-04 | Difficulty: 2 | Confusable: R09-04
Single-occupant use needs paid pass account; clean-fuel decal is separate windshield authorization [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0050]

FACT_ID: R09-06 | anchor: A03
Group: freeway-entry-exit | Prereq: R09-02 | Difficulty: 2 | Confusable: R09-07
Use acceleration lane to match speed; exit early and steady; metered ramp admits one vehicle per green [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0050]

FACT_ID: R09-07 | anchor: A04
Group: special-interchanges | Prereq: R09-06 | Difficulty: 3 | Confusable: R09-09
Runaway ramp emergency-only with no stopping; SPUI off-ramp U-turn allowed on green arrow, never stop mid-crossing [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0051]

FACT_ID: R09-08 | anchor: A05
Group: intersections | Prereq: none | Difficulty: 2 | Confusable: R09-15
Approach slow and scan; stop behind line; look left-right-left; cross without lane change; then merge right [A05]
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0051]

FACT_ID: R09-09 | anchor: A06
Group: special-interchanges | Prereq: R09-08 | Difficulty: 3 | Confusable: R09-07
Continuous-flow, diverging-diamond and thru-U-turn each redirect lefts; follow staged signals and lane guides [A06]
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0052]

FACT_ID: R09-10 | anchor: A08
Group: markings | Prereq: none | Difficulty: 2 | Confusable: R09-04
Yellow divides opposing flow; white divides same-direction flow; stop behind line and yield in crosswalk; shared center lane entry limited [A08]
Source: [A08 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0054]

FACT_ID: R09-11 | anchor: A09
Group: speed | Prereq: none | Difficulty: 2 | Confusable: R09-10
Basic law is reasonable-and-prudent; posted defaults by area; slow for hazards; too-slow impeding is citable [A09]
Source: [A09 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0054]

FACT_ID: R09-12 | anchor: A10
Group: signals | Prereq: none | Difficulty: 2 | Confusable: R09-13
Green go-if-clear; green arrow only-arrow-direction after yielding; yellow about-to-red; flashing yellow caution [A10]
Source: [A10 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0055]

FACT_ID: R09-13 | anchor: A11
Group: signals | Prereq: R09-12 | Difficulty: 3 | Confusable: R09-12
Red stop-and-wait; right-on-red after stop unless barred; flashing red stop-then-go; red arrows stop; officer overrides signal; dead signal stop-first [A11]
Source: [A11 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0056]

FACT_ID: R09-14 | anchor: A12
Group: signs | Prereq: none | Difficulty: 2 | Confusable: R09-12
Guide informs; railroad X needs caution and stop discipline; regulatory commands; warning diamonds alert; work-zone orange with doubled speeding fine and flagger obedience [A12]
Source: [A12 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0057]

FACT_ID: R09-15 | anchor: A12
Group: right-of-way | Prereq: R09-08 | Difficulty: 2 | Confusable: R09-08
Never assume priority; yield to prior arrival, oncoming on left turn, right-side tie, driveway entrant yields, ramp yields, and anyone still inside [A12]
Source: [A12 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0060]
